hooks.name: test-on-stop
hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn, build and run the whole test suite once (instead of building on every file save); output goes to stderr so build errors and assert messages reach the agent

hooks.name: guard-migrations
hooks.description: Remind the agent never to hand-edit generated migration Designer files or the model snapshot

action.prompt: A generated EF Core file under Migrations/ (a .Designer.cs or the model snapshot) was saved. If `dotnet ef migrations add/remove` just produced it, ignore this message. Otherwise revert the hand edit: change the model and run `dotnet ef migrations add <Name>` instead. Adding custom SQL (for example a data backfill) to the Up/Down methods of a new migration is fine.
